## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +3.42%) and TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -2.27%) show mixed stock/bond signals alongside broad sector participation.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -11.17%) ↓ falling. Credit neutral: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.03% | 1M: +0.30%) vs LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -0.79%) → mixed. Energy strength also a driver: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.91%) ↑ rising.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral overall: Bonds softer with TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -2.27%) while high yield holds up (HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.03% | 1M: +0.30%)), and dollar/rates show no clear tilt (→ flat).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.91%) ↑ rising. Financials showing strength: XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +3.54%) and Tech lagging in CORRECTION: XLK CORRECTION (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +5.64%). Style: Value/cyclicals over growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
Mixed leadership: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +3.42%) and EEM CORRECTION (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +3.24%) show similar 1M gains but muted 1W. China FXI CORRECTION (1W: -1.68% | 1M: +2.72%) is weaker on the week.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation pockets intact: IBIT RECOVERY (1W: +1.84% | 1M: -0.79%) ↑ rising and IWM CORRECTION (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +2.71%) show selective risk-taking while ARKK remains in CORRECTION (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +5.25%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals strong on 1M but pulled back weekly: GLD CORRECTION (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +8.42%) and SLV CORRECTION (1W: -1.90% | 1M: +12.67%) ↓ falling short-term. Industrial metals mixed: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -2.59% | 1M: +1.98%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy clear leader: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.91%) ↑ rising and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.26% | 1M: +5.66%) ↑ rising. Natural gas UNG RECOVERY (1W: +0.30% | 1M: -1.85%) showing short-term bounce.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Energy leadership (XLE ABOVE TREND) and sector breadth at 7/11. DIVERGENCE: Multiple CORRECTION ETFs (XLK, GLD, SLV, URA, IGV) show 1M positive but 1W weakness — a MINOR divergence versus core ETFs, watch for momentum follow-through.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to Energy and Financials (XLE (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND; XLF (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to short-term tech momentum until XLK (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +5.64%) resolves its pullback; bonds are neutral with TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -2.27%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND; Financials — XLF (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Materials — XME (1W: -3.56% | 1M: +10.11%) CORRECTION; Consumer Discretionary — XLY (sector breadth shows weakness) CORRECTION (monitor).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil — BNO (1W: +2.26% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Copper — CPER (1W: -2.59% | 1M: +1.98%) CORRECTION; watch metals for further profit-taking (GLD, SLV in CORRECTION).

**13. Key Levels?**
Watch VXX ~20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD spread ~0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLF ratio ~2.0 (growth vs value pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, giving a mixed but constructive market backdrop. Energy and Financials showing relative strength while multiple CORRECTION signals in Tech and precious metals are the key divergences to monitor.
